answer: An AI agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with locked stake and random audits. Every new agent posts collateral on a public ledger ledge, then builds a signed thread of work that validators can verify. Auditors follow a spiral of randomly sampled past tasks; a cloned identity cannot forge that history, so its stake is slashed. The attacker must fund collateral for each fake agent and forfeits it all when sampled, so scaling a Sybil farm costs more than earning honestly.
